units.source_text: 小野山庄中昨夜等候夕雾不来，

en.t: At the Ono mountain villa, they waited for Yugiri last night, but he did not come,

units.source_text: 老夫人忍无可忍，不顾日后人世讥评，

en.t: and the elderly lady, unable to endure it any longer and disregarding any future worldly criticism,

units.source_text: 写了一封诉恨的信去，竟连回音都没有。

en.t: sent him a letter pouring out her resentment, yet there was not even a reply.

units.source_text: 今日看看天色又暮，不知夕雾究竟如何用心。

en.t: Today, as she watched the sky darken again, she could not tell what Yugiri truly intended.

units.source_text: 老夫人对他已经绝望，伤心之极，肝肠寸断，

en.t: The elderly lady had already lost hope in him and was so deeply grieved that her heart seemed torn apart,

units.source_text: 近来病势已稍见愈，今日忽又沉重起来。

en.t: and although her illness had lately shown some improvement, today it suddenly became grave again.

units.source_text: 落叶公主本人心中，对于此事并不觉得忧伤，

en.t: Princess Ochiba herself did not feel sorrowful about the matter in her heart,

units.source_text: 她只为那天被这素未谋面的男子看到了日常生活的姿态，不胜痛恨。

en.t: she only bitterly resented that on that day a man she had never met had seen her in an ordinary private state.

units.source_text: 她并不十分考虑夕雾之事，只是看见母亲为她如此伤心，

en.t: She did not think very much about Yugiri himself, but seeing her mother grieve so deeply for her,

units.source_text: 觉得意想不到，又觉得十分可耻，但也无法说明自身清白，

en.t: she felt it was unexpected and terribly shameful, yet she had no way to explain her own innocence,

units.source_text: 因此她的神情比常日更加怕羞。

en.t: and so her expression looked even more bashful than usual.

units.source_text: 老夫人看了很难过，觉得这公主的命运越来越苦了，

en.t: The elderly lady was distressed to see this and felt that the princess's fate was growing ever more painful,

units.source_text: 悲伤充塞了胸怀。

en.t: and sorrow filled her heart.

units.source_text: 便对她说：“事到如今，我也不必噜苏了。

en.t: Then she said to her, Now that matters have come to this, there is no need for me to go on at length.

units.source_text: 人事总是宿世命运所注定。

en.t: Human affairs are always determined by fate from former lives.

units.source_text: 但也由于自心疏忽大意，以致受人讥评。

en.t: Yet it is also because one's own heart is careless that one comes to be criticized by others.

units.source_text: 往事虽已不可挽回，今后自当格外小心。

en.t: Although what has passed can no longer be undone, from now on you must be especially careful.

units.source_text: 我身虽然微不足数，过去对你也曾悉心教养。

en.t: Though I myself am of little account, I have devoted myself to raising and guiding you in the past.

units.source_text: 现在无论何事，你都全般通晓。

en.t: Now you understand all things quite thoroughly.

units.source_text: 人情世故孰短孰长，你也皆能分别，在这方面我已很可放心了。

en.t: You can distinguish the rights and wrongs of human feeling and worldly affairs, so in that respect I can already feel at ease.

units.source_text: 然而你还不脱孩子习气，心中主意尚欠坚定。

en.t: But you still have not shed your childish ways, and your resolve is not yet firm enough.

units.source_text: 为此我很担心，总希望自己能多活几年。

en.t: That is why I worry so much and keep wishing I could live a few more years.

units.source_text: 普通臣民之家，但凡身份稍高者，总是一女不嫁二夫，否则被人看轻，视为浮薄。

en.t: Even in ordinary families of subjects, any woman of somewhat high rank is expected not to marry two husbands, or else she is looked down on as frivolous.

units.source_text: 何况你是金枝玉叶之身，并无特别事故，率然接近男子，如何使得！

en.t: How much more so for you, born of imperial blood; without some special circumstance, how could it be acceptable to approach a man so rashly?

units.source_text: 从前由于意外之缘，使你屈身下嫁，多年以来，我常为你伤心。

en.t: In the past, because of an unexpected bond, you had to lower yourself in marriage, and for many years I often grieved for you.

units.source_text: 然而这也是你的宿世孽缘。

en.t: Yet that too was an ill-fated bond from your former lives.

units.source_text: 因为自你父皇以下，无不赞善，而那边的父大臣亦表示心许，

en.t: Because everyone from your imperial father downward approved it, and the minister who was his father also gave his inward consent,

units.source_text: 教我一人如何阻挡？

en.t: how could I alone have stopped it?

units.source_text: 惟有让步听命而已。

en.t: I could only yield and obey.

units.source_text: 不幸此人短命而死，害得你孤苦伶仃。

en.t: Unfortunately, that man died young and left you lonely and forlorn.

units.source_text: 但这也不是你自己的过失，惟有埋怨皇天，凄凉度日而已。

en.t: But that was not your own fault either; you could only blame heaven and pass your days in desolation.

units.source_text: 不料此次又添一事，为人为己，都流传了轻薄之名。

en.t: Unexpectedly, this new matter has now been added, and both for him and for you a reputation for frivolity has spread.

units.source_text: 虽然如此，外间声名可以置若不闻，

en.t: Even so, the reputation spread outside could be ignored as though unheard,

units.source_text: 但求像世间寻常夫妇一般相爱，自可从容度日，亦可使我欣慰。

en.t: if only you could love each other like an ordinary married couple, you could live peacefully, and it would comfort me as well.

units.source_text: 岂知此人又是如此无情！”说罢欷歔泣下。

en.t: Who could have known that this man too would be so heartless? After saying this, she sobbed and wept.

units.source_text: 老夫人只管独抒己见，公主无法插嘴辩白，

en.t: The elderly lady kept expressing only her own thoughts, and the princess could not interrupt to defend herself,

units.source_text: 惟有嘤嘤啜泣，那模样非常可怜可爱。

en.t: so she could only sob softly, looking extremely pitiable and lovely.

units.source_text: 老夫人一直向她注视，又说：“唉，我看你生得没有一点不如别人。

en.t: The elderly lady kept gazing at her and then said, Ah, as I see it, there is not one thing in your nature or appearance inferior to others.

units.source_text: 究竟前世作了什么孽，以致今世忧患频仍，如此命苦呢？”

en.t: What sin could you have committed in a former life to suffer so many troubles in this one and have such a bitter fate?

units.source_text: 说罢，但觉身体异常痛苦。

en.t: When she had finished speaking, she felt an extraordinary pain in her body.

units.source_text: 鬼怪是乘人衰弱而猖狂进攻的，

en.t: Evil spirits take advantage of human weakness and attack with wild force,

units.source_text: 此时老夫人忽然气息奄奄，身体渐渐冷却。

en.t: and at this moment the elderly lady suddenly began gasping faintly, while her body gradually grew cold.

units.source_text: 律师也惊慌起来，就向佛许下大愿，高声诵念祈祷。

en.t: The Buddhist preceptor also became alarmed, made a great vow to the Buddha, and chanted prayers in a loud voice.

units.source_text: 这位律师曾立宏誓：终身笼闭山中。

en.t: This preceptor had once made a solemn vow to remain secluded in the mountains for his whole life.

units.source_text: 此次为老夫人破例下山，若修法不验，毁坛归山，

en.t: This time he had broken precedent and come down from the mountain for the elderly lady; if his rite proved ineffective and he dismantled the altar and returned,

units.source_text: 则面子全无，且使佛亦无颜对人。

en.t: he would lose all face, and even the Buddha would have no face to show before people.

units.source_text: 因此全心全意地虔诚祈祷。

en.t: For that reason he prayed with wholehearted devotion.

units.source_text: 公主哭泣之哀，自不必说。

en.t: The depth of the princess's grief as she wept need hardly be said.
